description: Today's Zensei Index for U.S. equities: the final score, its regime label, and the three layer scores (structural conditions, tactical filters, regime confirmations). The Zensei Index is a RISK score from 0 to 100: LOWER IS HEALTHIER. 0-20 Supportive, 20-40 Vulnerable, 40-70 Stressed, 70-100 Restrictive. A rising score means conditions are deteriorating, not improving. Call zensei_index_indicators to see why the score sits where it does.
